title: Vance breaks ranks, ties Republican losses to the Iran war
summary: Vice President JD Vance has given an unusually blunt account of why his party lost ground in the midterms, pointing to the conflict with Iran. The comments stand out as one of the sharpest public departures from a sitting president by his own deputy in years.

title: Netanyahu claims fraud over Arab turnout in Israeli vote
summary: Benjamin Netanyahu and his allies say Arab voters unfairly decided last month's election. Electoral officials confirm some irregularities are under investigation but insist they could not have changed the outcome.

title: Israeli party chiefs meet Herzog over who forms next government
summary: President Isaac Herzog is consulting party leaders on which candidate should get the first mandate to build a coalition. The talks open the formal process of choosing Israel's next prime minister.

title: What a Democratic Congress could mean for Iran, Gaza and Ukraine
summary: Democrats made major gains in the midterms but fall short of the two thirds needed to override a presidential veto. That limits how far they can force changes to US policy on the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine.

title: Democrats take Congress, but the veto still belongs to Trump
summary: With control of Congress, Democrats can now pass their own bills and steer investigations. Any legislation, however, still faces a possible presidential veto.

title: Pressure builds for Hegseth impeachment after midterm shift
summary: A Democratic House could approve articles of impeachment against Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth. Removal would still require Republican votes in the Senate.

title: Security officer killed in knife attack in Amman
summary: A member of the security forces has died after a stabbing in the Jordanian capital. Details are still emerging.

title: Fresh wave of bomb threats grounds flights across Europe
summary: Several aircraft, including flights in Italy and France, were diverted or checked after threats were phoned in. All landed safely and officials say no explosives were discovered.

title: Older voters helped carry Lula to victory in Brazil
summary: Elderly Brazilians, some voting for the first time in years, are being credited with tipping the runoff toward President Lula. He defeated the far right challenger Flávio Bolsonaro.

title: Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong handed ten year sentence
summary: Joshua Wong, who became the face of the city's pro democracy movement, has been jailed for a decade under the national security law. He is one of hundreds held under the legislation.

title: British health worker with Ebola flown home from Congo
summary: A British healthcare worker infected with Ebola is being brought back from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient is said to be stable and will be treated in a specialist isolation unit.

title: France braces for nationwide strike over living costs
summary: Unions have called more than 200 demonstrations across France on Thursday. The action escalates weeks of protest against rising prices.
